title: Hilbert-Schmidt norm: comparison with the operator norm and triangle inequality
statement: For all natural numbers m, k and all continuous linear maps A, B : R^m -> R^k (Rn m ->L[R] Rn k), writing hsNormSq A = sum_{i<m} |A e_i|^2 (e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 the standard basis of R^m), hsNorm A = sqrt(hsNormSq A), and ||A|| for the operator norm: (i) ||A|| <= hsNorm A; (ii) hsNorm A <= sqrt(m) * ||A||; (iii) hsNorm (A + B) <= hsNorm A + hsNorm B.
lean_statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (A B : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k), ‖A‖ ≤ hsNorm A ∧ hsNorm A ≤ Real.sqrt m * ‖A‖ ∧ hsNorm (A + B) ≤ hsNorm A + hsNorm B
